Interface ISecuritySearchProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseSecuritySearchProvider, BivaSecuritySearch, BoursoramaSecuritySearch, ConsorsbankSecuritySearch, EodhdSecuritySearch, EuronextSecuritySearch, NasdaqNordicSecuritySearch, OnvistaSecuritySearch, OpenFigiSecuritySearch, SixSecuritySearch, ViennaSecuritySearch, XetraSecuritySearch, YahooSymbolSearch
public interface ISecuritySearchProvider
A data provider that can look up instrument listings by ISIN, currency and MIC. The interface is deliberately separate from IFeedConnector: not every price connector offers a search, and a metadata provider such as OpenFIGI supplies no prices at all. Whether a provider is usable for searching is therefore decided here and not by the activation of a price connector. What the search covers, however, is taken from the price connector of the same data source when there is one (getFeedConnectorShortId()).

A search never writes anything and never throws. Every failure - missing credentials, rate limits, timeouts or a provider error - is reported as a SecuritySearchStatus, so that a caller merging several providers keeps the results of the others.

  • Method Details

    • getProviderId

      String getProviderId()
      Short id of the provider, used as providerId of its candidates and for selecting providers.
      Returns:
      the id, e.g. yahoo, openfigi, six or xetra

    • supports

      boolean supports(SecuritySearchQuery query)
      Tells whether the provider can answer the query at all, for example because it covers only one exchange or needs an ISIN.
      Parameters:
      query - the search query
      Returns:
      true when search(SecuritySearchQuery) would ask the provider

    • getFeedConnectorShortId

      default Optional<String> getFeedConnectorShortId()
      Names the price connector of the same data source, e.g. six for SixFeedConnector. Its IFeedConnector.supports then decides which exchanges and instrument types the search covers, so that the coverage is declared in one place. A provider without such a connector, like OpenFIGI, declares its coverage with covers(AssetclassType, SpecialInvestmentInstruments).
      Returns:
      the short id of the connector, or empty when the data source has no price connector

    • covers

      default boolean covers(AssetclassType categoryType, SpecialInvestmentInstruments sii)
      Tells whether the provider can find instruments of a type. Only asked when the provider names no price connector.
      Parameters:
      categoryType - asset class type chosen by the user
      sii - financial instrument chosen by the user
      Returns:
      true when a search for this type is worthwhile

    • search

      SecuritySearchResult search(SecuritySearchQuery query)
      Searches the provider for listings matching the query. Candidates contradicting the supplied ISIN, currency or MIC are removed and only counted.
      Parameters:
      query - the search query
      Returns:
      the result with its status; never null

    • supportsBaseData

      default boolean supportsBaseData(SecuritySearchCandidateDto candidate)
      Tells whether the provider can deliver master data for a candidate. Master data is always requested for a candidate of the same provider, keyed by its provider instrument id or provider symbol.
      Parameters:
      candidate - a candidate returned by search(SecuritySearchQuery)
      Returns:
      true when getSecurityBaseData(SecuritySearchCandidateDto, Locale) would ask the provider

    • getSecurityBaseData

      default SecurityBaseDataResult getSecurityBaseData(SecuritySearchCandidateDto candidate, Locale locale)
      Fetches the master data of a candidate from the provider's detail endpoint. Like the search, this never throws; a detail endpoint whose ISIN or currency contradicts the candidate results in SecuritySearchStatus.NO_MATCH.
      Parameters:
      candidate - a candidate returned by search(SecuritySearchQuery) of this provider
      locale - language of the user, used for links to pages offered in several languages
      Returns:
      the result with its status; never null
